text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High p99 latency detected for /v1/generate (rdx-13B-quant) — 12:07 UTC. p95 ~1.2s (baseline 0.35s), p99 ~3.2s. Streaming stalls observed. @maya_oncall paging (sev=2). :rotating_light:

Maya (oncall): Ack. Looking now. Which region? any affected customers called out?

EJensen: eu-west-1 mainly (cluster inf-eu-a). Alerts show steep tail starting ~12:01, correlated with node gpu-24 (host:gpunode-eu-24).

Maya (oncall): pulling traces and recent deploys. No deploys in last 2 hours from deploy-bot.

ops-runner: adding logs: ```
kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving -o wide | grep rdx-13B
# shows a few pods on gpunode-eu-24 in CrashLoop or NotReady
```

Kumar: I see ECC events on gpunode-eu-24 in the node logs: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus" and repeated thermal warnings 85-90C. GPU driver reported soft reset attempts.

Sara (prod-eng): That explains stalls: streaming shards waiting on slow/failed device. Percentage of traffic hitting that node?

EJensen: Autoscaler had 6 replicas; two were scheduled to gpunode-eu-24. Roughly 32% of active sessions during window touched those replicas based on LB sticky routing. Customer impact: a handful of latency-sensitive customers saw increased timeouts, volume about 4% of overall requests (spike window).

Maya (oncall): Mitigation plan — immediate and short: 1) cordon + drain gpunode-eu-24, 2) scale up fallback pool (rdx-13B-quant-safe) and shift traffic, 3) enable model fallback routing rule to rdx-13B-int8 if quality acceptable, 4) open customer communications for impacted tenants. Executing step 1 now.

ops-runner: Running: ``kubectl cordon gpunode-eu-24 && kubectl drain gpunode-eu-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data -n redwood-serving``

infra-bot: Notice: node gpunode-eu-24 marked Unschedulable. Drain started at 12:12 UTC. Pod eviction in progress.

Kumar: While draining, let's patch the routing rule: set policy to prefer model-variant "rdx-13B-int8" for new sessions in eu-west-1. Command: ``/inc route-set --region eu-west-1 --model rdx-13B-int8 --pct 100 --reason "emergency fallback"``

Sara (prod-eng): Doing that now. Pushing fallback 100% for new sessions in eu-west-1. Existing sessions will continue but will be rerouted on retry.

Maya (oncall): Observability checks — p95 now down to 420ms, p99 980ms. Still elevated but much better. Streaming stalls metric dropped by ~70%.

EJensen: Confirmed :thumbsup: New sessions grazing rdx-13B-int8. Customer error rate for impacted tenants dropping. We're still seeing retries and some long-lived sessions failing.

Kumar: For the degraded node, I'm collecting hardware logs. Running: ``sudo journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced --since "12:00" | tail -n 200`` and ``nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv -l 1``. Output attached to thread.

Maya (oncall): Post-drain: node gpunode-eu-24 shows repeated ECC errors and throttling in dmesg. Kernel reports "GPU thermal throttling engaged" and driver soft-resets. Marking node for maintenance.

ops-runner: Node drained. All serving pods rescheduled to other healthy nodes, autoscaler spun up two additional replicas in eu-west-1.

Sara (prod-eng): Rolling audit: need to run health-check sweep to ensure no KV cache corruption from interrupted sessions. Starting evals on prompt sets for rdx-13B-int8 vs rdx-13B-quant for customer-critical prompts.

EJensen: Customer impact assessment: 4% of traffic experienced >1s latencies; 0.5% saw timeouts. No data loss. Affected tenants: AcmeCorp (rate-limited retries), BetaApp (timeouts on streaming). Recommend RTO messaging to account teams.

Maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline for incident wrap in 20min, Kumar will take lead for postmortem & hardware triage. @Kumar please confirm.

Kumar: Confirmed. I'll open an incident ticket (INC-2026-248) with attached logs and schedule hardware replacement if the vendor sees persistent ECC. I'll also coordinate with infra to isolate similar nodes (gpunode-eu-22..e-26) for health checks.

infra-bot: Suggested next steps saved to ticket INC-2026-248: firmware check, run nvidia-driver reinstallation, vendor RMA windows.

Sara (prod-eng): We'll keep the fallback routes for 24h and monitor quality regressions. If rdx-13B-int8 drift is nontrivial, we'll rollback to a smaller percentage and spin additional dedicated capacity.

Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Final notes: severity downgraded to SEV-3 (impact contained), SLO breach window recorded 12:01–12:18 UTC. Create postmortem draft and link to ticket.

EJensen: I'll ping accounts and ops to confirm customer messages sent.

ops-runner: logs + core dumps uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-2026-248/gpunode-eu-24/ (link shared privately).

Maya (oncall): Closing active paging. If any regressions, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
